plan.title: Fitness Programme Results
plan.subtitle: Summary of participant growth and performance metrics from baseline to endline

panels.title: Avg Height Gain (cm)
panels.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(e."Height cm" - b."Height cm"), 1) AS avg_gain FROM "baseline" b JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"

panels.title: Avg Sit-ups Improvement
panels.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(e."Sit ups" - b."Sit ups"), 1) AS avg_improvement FROM "baseline" b JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"

panels.title: Avg Performance by Coach
panels.sql: SELECT e."Coach", ROUND(AVG(e."Sit ups"), 1) AS avg_situps FROM "endline" e GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top 5 Locations by Growth
panels.sql: SELECT e."Location", ROUND(AVG(e."Height cm" - b."Height cm"), 2) AS avg_height_gain, ROUND(AVG(e."Sit ups" - b."Sit ups"), 1) AS avg_situp_gain FROM "baseline" b JOIN "endline" e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

plan.narrative: The programme engaged {{p1}} children, demonstrating measurable physical improvements across the cohort. On average, participants gained {{p2}} in height and improved their core strength by {{p3}} sit-ups between the baseline and endline assessments. These gains indicate a positive impact on the participants' physical development. When analyzing performance by coach, the data shows that {{p4}} leads in average sit-up counts, suggesting effective coaching methodologies in that group. Geographically, the location {{p5}} shows the highest average height gain, highlighting regional variations in growth outcomes that may warrant further investigation into local nutrition or activity levels.
